description: A note's yield is the annual return that makes its remaining payments (and any balloon) worth exactly the price paid, and this tool solves for it. It assumes every payment is made on time. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

balloon.description: Balloon (lump sum) due with the last payment, USD. Default 0.

months.description: Number of monthly payments LEFT (not the original term).

payment.description: Monthly payment in USD (principal and interest).

price.description: Price paid for the note, USD.

name: note_yield
title: Note yield calculator
